scope: two nodes, one rank and one MI250X GCD per node, one cross-node CXI peer per rank

deployment_constraints.note: proxy producer concurrency is bounded by min(grid_blocks, proxy_worker_lanes); forced IPC is not legal for this deployment

evaluation_contract.execution: each named kernel scenario is timed independently with equal score weight
evaluation_contract.primary_score: geometric mean of per-scenario slowdown relative to the measured legal-action oracle
evaluation_contract.secondary_score: sum of per-scenario median wall times
evaluation_contract.candidate_budget: one decision per compiler site; no source edits or generated code

action_notes.proxy: device pushes commands into CPU-worker rings; independent static sites may use distinct lanes
action_notes.trigger: host stages compiler-reconstructed descriptors and releases the batch through DWQ
action_notes.ipc: same-node path only and unavailable under this cross-node placement contract

provenance.deployment: one rank per node with GICC_NUM_PROXY_THREADS=8
